findings.source_quote: And he called his ten servants, and delivered them ten pounds, and said unto them, Occupy till I come –Luke 19:12-13.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the phrase “Occupy till I come” into natural, idiomatic Hindi that conveys the charge to use/manage/engage the resources until the master returns. For example: "और उन से कहा, 'मेरे आने तक काम में लगो'" or "'मेरे आने तक इनसे कारोबार करते रहो'". Preserve the verse reference and surrounding HTML.

findings.source_quote: That the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give unto you the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him: The eyes of your understanding being enlightened;
findings.suggested_fix: Use a more natural Hindi rendering for “spirit of wisdom and revelation” (प्रकटव्य का आत्मा is awkward). Suggested: "बुद्धि और प्रकटता का आत्मा" or "बुद्धि और प्रकट होने की आत्मा" so the meaning is clear. Preserve surrounding punctuation, emphasis tags, and verse reference.
findings.translation_quote: "वह आपको उसके ज्ञान में बुद्धि और प्रकटव्य का आत्मा दें; आपके समझ के नेत्र प्रकाशित हों;"
